mapper.sql: select d.device_id, d.device_code, d.resource_id, r.resource_name, d.resource_type, d.resource_spec, d.cluster_name, d.node_name, d.slot_index, d.uuid, d.pci_bus, d.status, d.alloc_id, d.apply_no, d.user_name, d.bind_time, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark from biz_device d left join biz_resource r on r.resource_id = d.resource_id
mapper.select: where d.resource_id = #{resourceId} and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' order by d.node_name asc, d.slot_index asc
select count(1) from biz_device where resource_id = #{resourceId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from biz_device where del_flag = '0' and status = #{status}
